title: Not the biggest, the best run
intro: Every day your city scores Influence: how much Payroll it got for every Capital it has spent. The best-run cities, not the biggest, share prizes in stock tokens.
note: Prizes are stock tokens bought with the trading toll, not other players' Capital. You claim them yourself.
